## Known gaps (from the researcher)

- **Meme literacy and a meme SFX/sound library**: Gaming and gym humour trends depend on exact meme sounds (vine boom, record scratch, scream, mimimi) and their timing. real-sfx has no recorded library configured (libraries: []), only UI cues; library/ did not exist at check time.
- **Transitions recipes**: The Brain's Transitions topic has no cheat-sheet entries. Current trends rely on specific transitions: fan-blade mask, phone-flip, swipe/whip, shoe kick, leg swipe, freeze/glitch frame.
- **Colour grading recipes**: The Colour topic has no cheat-sheet entries; only the System Prompt's gym defaults exist. Lock-in moody grades, cinematic travel and RGB rooms need recipes.
- **Music licensing and trending-audio access**: Creator vs business account audio libraries, Shorts revenue split with music, Content ID, which trending songs are commercially cleared (e.g. 'Autumn Colors' cleared for business).
- **YouTube (Shorts and long-form) playbook**: The Brain is Instagram-heavy. Missing: the Oct 1 2026 Shorts originality ranking change, the YPP change from Feb 1 2027 (10M Shorts views in 90 days), titles, thumbnails, chapters, paired-Shorts series.
- **Originality and reuse rules (reactions, clips, compilations)**: YouTube (Oct 1) and Instagram down-rank low-effort reposts; X's Original Content Rewards too. Needed before any reaction, esports or meme-clip format.
- **Gaming production**: Nothing on PC capture (OBS/ShadowPlay), console capture, 16:9 to 9:16 crops with facecam, game audio, Rockstar/publisher video policies, spoiler etiquette.
- **Tech filming craft**: Nothing on product macro shots, tabletop lighting, filming monitors (flicker, banding, moire) and RGB rooms with an iPhone, or screen recording for native-interface tutorials.
- **Performance: lip-sync, deadpan and skit acting**: Many current trends (Two Fishes, Upside Down, Be OK, skits, pranks) depend on delivery; the Brain covers yapping but not performance.
- **Health and supplement claims in India**: Peptides, stimulants and creatine content is hot. The Brain lacks rules on evidence standards and Indian regulation (FSSAI/CDSCO), beyond the System Prompt's 'no PEDs'.
- **Sponsorship disclosure and affiliate (India)**: Festive-sale deal reels are often sponsored; ASCI influencer disclosure rules, Amazon/Flipkart affiliate links and YouTube Shopping (coming to India) are not covered.
- **Indian culture and release calendar**: Diwali sales (Oct 28 onward), GTA 6 (Nov 19), LoL Worlds final (Nov 14), BGMI Survivor League (to Nov 17), Ramayana (Nov 5) and Avengers: Doomsday (Dec 18) drive reach; no calendar exists in the Brain.
- **Trend lifecycle and timing**: Audio trends peak in about 7 to 10 days, formats run 3 to 4 weeks (Vaizle/Sozee). Stage thresholds by sound video count (CloutMap via Sozee: under 1K emerging, 1K-20K growth, 20K-200K peak, 200K+ saturated). Not in the Brain.
- **Instagram and Edits feature changes (Sep to Oct 2026)**: Edits: text keyframes (Oct 19), beat-synced effects test, carousels in Edits, Audio Links and Creator Kits; Instagram: Linked Reels removed Oct 28, Reels-first feed test, timestamped comments in development. Not in the Brain.
- **AI video tools and disclosure**: AI transitions, face-swap edits (e.g. @creyate.ai 4.9M) and ChatGPT workflows are a live tech format; no notes on tools or on AI-content labelling.
- **Gear gaps**: No mic, no second camera, no overhead or POV mount, no gimbal and no capture card are recorded; several trends need one of these.
